name: Undertale
description: Undertale plugin for Binary Ninja. Currently: right-click a function to name it via the Undertale Inference Server.
longdescription: Binary Ninja integration for the Undertale Inference Server. The current action reads the selected function's disassembly, sends it to the server's function-naming API, and renames the function to the predicted name. On first use, prompts once for the Inference Server connection (a TCP host:port, or the path to a Unix domain socket) and reuses it for subsequent requests.
